proposals.summary: Targeted research & development plan addressing: Acid mine discharge (pH 3.2) containing dissolved iron and sulfate leaching into Katras Nullah contaminating local drink.

proposals.problemTitle: Severe groundwater arsenic contamination in Netarhat

proposals.problemTitle: High Arsenic & Heavy Metal in Torpa Village Borewell
proposals.title: JalShuddhi Plus: Advanced Ion-Exchange Arsenic Filter
proposals.summary: Modular bio-char and ion-exchange filter for high arsenic groundwater.
proposals.technicalApproach: Adsorption column with ESP32 turbidity telemetry
proposals.expectedOutcome: BIS 10500 compliant potable water < 0.01 ppm arsenic

proposals.title: JalShuddhi Plus: Advanced Ion-Exchange Arsenic Filter

proposals.problemTitle: Heavy Arsenic and Fluoride Contamination in Angara Block Borewells
proposals.title: JalShuddhi: Solar-Powered Nano-Adsorptive Fluoride Filter with IoT Contamination Telemetry
proposals.summary: Development of a decentralized modular filtration pillar utilizing activated alumina and biochar nanoparticles to reduce fluoride below 0.8 ppm and arsenic below 5 ppb, coupled with solar-powered continuous spectrophotometric telemetry reporting live water quality to Ranchi district portal.
proposals.technicalApproach: Dual-stage adsorption cartridge + ESP32 IoT water conductivity & optical sensor + 50W mono-perc solar panel + GSM telemetry burst to JSICP gateway.
proposals.expectedOutcome: Safe potable water for 2,400+ residents in Hesal and Childag villages, zero recurring electricity cost, automated SMS alerts to Jal Sahiyyas upon cartridge exhaustion.

proposals.problemTitle: Post-Harvest Lac & Minor Forest Produce Processing Wastage in Torpa
proposals.title: VanDhan SolarLac: Portable Hybrid Solar Scraping & Deseeding Machine for Lac Farmers
proposals.summary: Ergonomic portable unit capable of processing 25kg lac per hour with 98% purity, powered by foldable solar panels and DC brushless motor.
proposals.technicalApproach: Planetary blade scrapper with rotary seed separator + solar MPPT charge controller + light-weight aluminum frame.
proposals.expectedOutcome: Zero post-harvest rot, 40% income enhancement for 350 tribal women in Torpa cluster.

proposals.problemTitle: Underground Coal Seam Fire & Toxic Methane Vents Near Jharia Basti
proposals.title: AgniShanti: Autonomous Thermal Drone & Fly-Ash Slurry Micro-Capping for Coal Fires
proposals.summary: Thermal infrared drone mapping to identify underground combustion hotspots, followed by high-pressure injection of geopolymer fly-ash composite slurry to smother oxygen ingress.
proposals.technicalApproach: Hexacopter with FLIR Boson 640 thermal camera + RTK GPS + automated nozzle injection rig.
proposals.expectedOutcome: 90% reduction in surface methane emissions and elimination of subsidence hazard across 4 bastis.

proposals.problemTitle: Cold-Chain Failure in Vaccine Delivery Across Deep Forest Villages of Dumka
proposals.universityName: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Deoghar
proposals.title: SwasthyaVahak: Smart PCM Solar Vaccine Carrier with LoRa Telemetry & GPS Geofencing
proposals.summary: Active PCM (Phase Change Material) cooling chamber maintaining 2°C to 8°C for up to 72 hours under 45°C ambient temperature, integrated with solar lid recharge and real-time cold-chain SMS alert triggers.
proposals.technicalApproach: Vacuum insulated panels + PCM gel pack + low-power STM32 telemetry unit + GPS/GSM antenna.
proposals.expectedOutcome: Zero vaccine potency loss across 42 remote Anganwadis and sub-centers in Dumka and Deoghar.
